entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: Event in 3307 AR on Tolaria in which a time machine rupture destroyed the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy on Tolaria invaded by Phyrexians and blasted apart.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Founder who sent Karn back in time and teleported Barrin and others away.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem who traveled back in time and survived the explosion.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Academy member who survived outside the time bubbles.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Academy member teleported away by Urza.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Academy member stuck in a slow-time bubble.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: Phyrexian sleeper agent who led the negators.

entities.name: Time Rift
entities.description: Rift torn above Tolaria, unnoticed for centuries.

events.summary: Phyrexian negators led by sleeper agent Kerrick invade the academy and kill Jhoira, Barrin and Teferi.
events.quote: Jhoira , Barrin and Teferi were all killed by Phyrexian negators led by the sleeper agent Kerrick

events.summary: Urza sends Karn 24 hours back in time; Karn stops Kerrick by breaking his leg, un-killing the three.
events.quote: by breaking Kerrick's leg and disabling him

events.summary: The time machine implodes; Urza teleports Barrin and thirteen others away before the time stream ruptures.
events.quote: Urza had just enough time to teleport Barrin and thirteen other students and teachers away from the island

events.summary: Temporal light blasts the academy apart, killing hundreds, creating time bubbles and tearing a Time Rift.
events.quote: killing hundreds of students and teachers

events.summary: Karn, immune thanks to his silver frame, saves 33 survivors and sails away; Jhoira survives on the island.
events.quote: He helped 33 students and teachers out of the academy's rubble and sailed them away from the island

relations.quote: led by the sleeper agent Kerrick
Urza bid Karn to travel 24 hours back in time
